svg.title: Live annotation beside a robot evaluation: one GPU, shared by turns
svg.desc: While a robot evaluation writes rollouts, the live service labels finished episodes with a local model, but only while the policy server is not inferring; its verdicts are automatic and unreviewed until a person reviews them.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A gate keeps the vision model out of the way while the policy is inferring.

svg.text: The service yields the GPU when another process computes; it holds the shared lock file while its model server is up. Start it before the policy server.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: It never writes the rollout folders, never connects to the robot, never writes a human outcome label.
